name: Agent Usage Status
description: Displays usage quotas, reset countdowns, pace projections, 7-day sparklines, and multi-account status for AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Antigravity, OpenRouter, GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, DeepSeek) in the GNOME top bar. Quota collection runs via the companion gnome-agent-status CLI binary, and a user-initiated "Copy Usage Summary" action copies a plain-text usage summary to the clipboard.
